Hero_Desc_Tig:
A swordmaster who demonstrates the great power of the werebeasts.
The only problem is that her other abilities are severely below average.
Seeing as how her weaknesses diminish her strengths, it seems the universe is quite just.
Album_Like_Tig: Strength and power. Her own sword.
Album_Hate_Tig: Anything that makes one doubt their path. Chow.
Album_Tig1: A young swordmaster from the Werebeast Village. Her swordsmanship is exceptional and she appears to be a skilled fighter. However, despite being a master with the blade, she is rather impatient and stubborn. Nevertheless, her devotion to the werebeasts seems genuine.
Album_Tig2: Tig often says her skills are still lacking. I think her swordsmanship is more than sufficient, so I find myself hoping she cultivates more wisdom instead.
Album_Tig3: They say Tig isn't only a good fighter. She studied under Diana, the sage of Werebeast Village, so she's fairly clever. Oddly, though, that has twisted her personality and made her unusually suspicious.
Album_Tig4: Even a simple statement makes Tig suspicious. She mulls it over in her head two or three times, which makes her an unexpectedly stubborn and difficult werebeast.
Album_Tig5: Elder Diana says Tig's insatiable curiosity is what made her this way. Apparently, Tig asked so many unnecessary questions that it often frustrated her.
Album_Tig6: Normally, Tig tries hard to seem like she knows everything, but as we grew closer, she started asking me all kinds of things. She even asked about the names of some flowers and trees we passed, and I answered as best I could because I found her adorable.
Album_Tig7: Tig asked me about the nature of the universe and existence itself. Then she asked what it truly means to "be". Since then, I've been doing everything I can to avoid her.

Food_ChefNote_Tig_Hate1: Tig saw this dish as an affront. She left a challenge before disappearing, saying she would come back in a week to wreck the place.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Hate2: Tig wrinkled her nose, saying this dish smelled like old people.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like1: Tig said the meat was cooked just right and appointed me the private chef of the Chow Rebels.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like2:
Tig liked this drink, saying it made her feel many times stronger.
Of course, I had to stop her from going on a rampage because her mind had also gone many times wilder.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like3: Tig will sometimes scoop up sand and eat it. She likes that she can eat this instead of sand. Let's not ask why she eats sand.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like4: She kept questioning whether the filling was beans, sesame, or honey before finally eating them.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like5: She first dismissed it as just flour, questioning if it was fake food... but after taking a bite, she admits it tastes good.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like6: Tig joked that she could finish off a log scarecrow with one strike. She then accidentally halved the table with a swing of her knife.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like7: Tig talked about the food giving you strength because it contained many ingredients. She didn't elaborate it further though.
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like8: Tig threw a tantrum, refusing to eat, and ended up dumping the whole box on the floor. But later, it seemed like she secretly picked them up to eat it. I really can't understand her...
Food_ChefNote_Tig_Like9: Tig was thrilled to have gathered the strongest candies of each race. "It's just food... does it hold any meaning?"

LoveLetter_Tig:
Hey! The old hag scolded me because of you!

The village chief beat me with her staff, saying that if I received something, I had to repay the favor like this! Should you not keep our old hag under control so this does not happen? Are you picking a fight with me? Be ready to take a beating on the Banquet Hall roof later!

Well~ I am grateful to you. But why should I have to express it while watching the old hag's mood? I have my own way of doing things! So be ready to receive a 'Thank-You Punch' later, understood?
LoveCall_Tig:
Hey, Master! It is Tig. I called for a moment while running an errand for the old hag.
Why did I contact you...? Um... Argh! I am allowed to call for no reason!
A strong warrior like me has to occasionally check whether weaklings like you are doing well. You should be grateful!

You know, for a weakling, you have been showing your face far too little lately.
If you are weak, act like it and rest when you need to. Working late every day with that frail body does not suit you.
What will you do if one little mistake puts you flat in bed?
...Tch! I am not worried! I am merely saying you are weak!
So... do not work too hard!

Anyway, you should also... call sometimes, even when you have no particular reason.
Unless you want to get beaten! I am hanging up!
